title: Raymond Realty jumps 6% on Q2 pre-sales

timeline.title: Raymond Realty jumps 6% on Q2 pre-sales
timeline.line: Q2 pre-sales nearly doubled (+98%) to ₹902 cr; collections rose 67% to ₹682 cr
more: The stock hit a day's high of ₹689.90, up 6.4%
The growth came without any new project launches in the quarter
